//go:build linux && !386 && !android

package sm_test

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/ctrlzy/go-diameter/v4/diam"
	"github.com/ctrlzy/go-diameter/v4/diam/sm"
)

type handshakeTraceEvent struct {
	at    time.Time
	phase string
	id    uint32
	n     int
	err   error
}
type handshakeTrace struct {
	mu       sync.Mutex
	events   [32]handshakeTraceEvent
	next     int
	maxWrite time.Duration
}

func (r *handshakeTrace) add(phase string, id uint32, n int, err error) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	r.events[r.next%len(r.events)] = handshakeTraceEvent{time.Now(), phase, id, n, err}
	r.next++
	r.mu.Unlock()
}
func (r *handshakeTrace) dump(t *testing.T) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	for i := r.next - len(r.events); i < r.next; i++ {
		if i >= 0 {
			e := r.events[i%len(r.events)]
			t.Logf("%s phase=%s id=%d n=%d err=%v", e.at.Format(time.RFC3339Nano), e.phase, e.id, e.n, e.err)
		}
	}
}

type handshakeTraceConn struct {
	diam.Conn
	trace *handshakeTrace
}

func (c handshakeTraceConn) send(b []byte, stream *uint) (int, error) {
	var id uint32
	if len(b) >= 20 {
		id = binary.BigEndian.Uint32(b[12:16])
	}
	c.trace.add("CEA-write-start", id, len(b), nil)
	start := time.Now()
	var n int
	var err error
	if stream == nil {
		n, err = c.Conn.Write(b)
	} else {
		n, err = c.Conn.WriteStream(b, *stream)
	}
	elapsed := time.Since(start)
	c.trace.mu.Lock()
	if elapsed > c.trace.maxWrite {
		c.trace.maxWrite = elapsed
	}
	c.trace.mu.Unlock()
	c.trace.add("CEA-write-end", id, n, err)
	return n, err
}
func (c handshakeTraceConn) Write(b []byte) (int, error) { return c.send(b, nil) }
func (c handshakeTraceConn) WriteStream(b []byte, stream uint) (int, error) {
	return c.send(b, &stream)
}
func (c handshakeTraceConn) CurrentWriterStream() uint {
	return c.Conn.(diam.MultistreamWriter).CurrentWriterStream()
}
func (c handshakeTraceConn) SetWriterStream(s uint) uint {
	return c.Conn.(diam.MultistreamWriter).SetWriterStream(s)
}
func (c handshakeTraceConn) ResetWriterStream() { c.Conn.(diam.MultistreamWriter).ResetWriterStream() }
func (c handshakeTraceConn) CloseNotify() <-chan struct{} {
	return c.Conn.(diam.CloseNotifier).CloseNotify()
}

type handshakeTraceHandler struct {
	machine *sm.StateMachine
	trace   *handshakeTrace
}

func (h handshakeTraceHandler) ServeDIAM(c diam.Conn, m *diam.Message) {
	h.trace.add("CER-received", m.Header.HopByHopID, m.Len(), nil)
	h.machine.ServeDIAM(handshakeTraceConn{c, h.trace}, m)
}
func (h handshakeTraceHandler) Error(e *diam.ErrorReport) { h.machine.Error(e) }
func (h handshakeTraceHandler) ErrorReports() <-chan *diam.ErrorReport {
	return h.machine.ErrorReports()
}
func TestHandshakeStressDiagnostic(t *testing.T) {
	trace := new(handshakeTrace)
	machine := integrationMachine()
	server := integrationServer(t, handshakeTraceHandler{machine, trace})
	cli := integrationClient(false)
	before, _ := os.ReadFile("/proc/net/sctp/snmp")
	t.Logf("go=%s kernel-independent GOMAXPROCS=%d budget=%v", runtime.Version(), runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0), cli.RetransmitInterval)
	var maxDial time.Duration
	for i := 0; i < 10000; i++ {
		trace.add("dial-start", uint32(i), 0, nil)
		start := time.Now()
		c, err := cli.DialExt("sctp4", server.Addr().String(), time.Second, nil)
		elapsed := time.Since(start)
		if elapsed > maxDial {
			maxDial = elapsed
		}
		if err != nil {
			trace.add("dial-failed", uint32(i), 0, err)
			trace.dump(t)
			for _, reports := range []<-chan *diam.ErrorReport{cli.Handler.ErrorReports(), machine.ErrorReports()} {
				select {
				case report := <-reports:
					t.Logf("read/handler report=%v", report.Error)
				default:
				}
			}
			after, _ := os.ReadFile("/proc/net/sctp/snmp")
			t.Logf("counters before:\n%s\ncounters after:\n%s", strings.TrimSpace(string(before)), strings.TrimSpace(string(after)))
			t.Fatalf("cycle=%d elapsed=%v: %v", i, elapsed, err)
		}
		trace.add("dial-complete", uint32(i), 0, nil)
		select {
		case peer := <-server.accepted:
			switch i % 3 {
			case 0:
				c.Close()
			case 1:
				if err := integrationShutdown(peer.(*diam.SCTPConn), false); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			case 2:
				if err := integrationShutdown(peer.(*diam.SCTPConn), true); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			integrationClosed(t, c)
			c.Close()
			server.release(peer)
		case <-time.After(time.Second):
			c.Close()
			t.Fatal("no accepted socket")
		}
	}
	trace.mu.Lock()
	maxWrite := trace.maxWrite
	trace.mu.Unlock()
	t.Logf("cycles=10000 max_dial=%v max_server_write=%v", maxDial, maxWrite)
}
